visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a brightly lit living room with white walls and a gray sofa, a man in a black cap and t-shirt sits beside a woman in a cream-colored sweatshirt at a white table. Four distinct apples—ranging from deep red to bright green—are arranged in a row in the foreground. The man speaks with energetic hand movements, while the woman rests her face on her hands, looking at the camera. (2) The scene shifts to a supermarket produce section with rows of yellow-green apples in green protective foam nets. Yellow price tags with black and red Chinese text are prominently displayed above the fruit crates. The camera panned across the display, showing a variety of other fruits like oranges in the background under bright fluorescent store lighting. (3) Returning to the indoor setting, the man picks up a yellow apple and shows it to the lens. He uses a silver peeler and a small knife to skin and slice the fruit on a wooden board. The woman watches his actions with interest. A graphic of a Somersby cider bottle appears as a picture-in-picture overlay during the discussion of the flavor profile. (4) A younger girl enters the frame, sitting next to the woman. Both take bites of the sliced apple, displaying surprised facial expressions and nodding in approval. Close-up shots capture the glistening texture of the freshly cut apple flesh and the man's hands as he expertly divides the fruit into segments for everyone to taste. (5) In a different location, a woman wearing a black Nike athletic t-shirt tastes a slice of apple. Her kitchen background includes stainless steel appliances and a modern counter. She speaks enthusiastically about the quality of the fruit. The edit cuts back to the original duo, who are now comparing the remaining red and yellow apples on the table. (6) The video concludes with a top-down shot of the table where multiple hands reach out to point at the preferred apples. The man and woman summarize their findings, with the woman gesturing towards a specific red apple as her favorite. The lighting remains consistent and bright throughout the entire sequence, maintaining a cheerful and informative atmosphere.
